title: tehas plugin skills --json
description: What tehas plugin skills [--chat <host>] --json prints, version 1: the skills of every ready plugin that are granted at its pin, for one chat host or all (docs/specs/2026-11-21-plugins-v2-chats.md, "In the chat"). A chat host puts each text in its instructions after its own rules, labelled with the plugin's label, and marks what a turn with it proposed as shaped by that plugin; every entry carries its plugin, pin and label, so a host needs no second lookup. The text is read from the plugin's repository at the pinned commit, never from what a run wrote, and sha256 is of those bytes. A held or refused plugin has no entry. The texts of all entries together are at most TEHAS_PLUGIN_SKILLS_MAX bytes. Plugins are a feature still being built, so this is not contract until the release that ships them. Every object is closed. The tests of console/core/src/plugin/schema.rs hold the sample beside this file to this schema.
